BillSection.RCWSLText: The following agencies may enter into financial contracts,paid from any funds of an agency, appropriated or nonappropriated, forthe purposes indicated and in not more than the principal amountsindicated, plus financing expenses and required reserves pursuant tochapter 39.94 RCW. State agencies may enter into agreements with the department ofgeneral administration and the state treasurer's office to developrequests to the legislature for acquisition of properties andfacilities through financial contracts. The agreements may includecharges for services rendered. Those noninstructional facilities of higher education institutionsauthorized in this section to enter into financial contracts are noteligible for state funded maintenance and operations.
